subject: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-12T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot credits extension & burn-rate check-in

Thanks for taking the call this morning, Jordan 
- quick recap and next steps below. Wanted to make the ask explicit so we can move the credit extension through approvals today.

Recap (from our demo + discovery):
- You're running two main flows: record ingestion -> clinical note summarization (seq len ~= 1k tokens) and a patient Q&A chat (shorter prompts, many calls).
- Current pilot is on a dedicated test dataset with a soft SLA; you're primarily validating quality and latency.
- Key constraint for you: stay within pilot budget while proving 95th pct latency and accuracy goals.

A few specific asks so we can qualify the extension:
1) Current burn: please confirm average daily tokens for the last 7 days and any recent spikes (CSV is perfect).
2) Expected usage during the next 14 days if we extend credits (estimate low/expected/high).
3) Budget range and target unit economics — what's your target $/1M tokens for production (or comfortable range)?
4) Any procurement requirements (PO, SOW, PII controls) we should be aware of before we approve multi-week credits.

If it helps, our typical pilot extension flow is to approve a fixed pool of free tokens (one-time credit) and then convert to a short-term committed reservation or pay-as-you-go based on your expected run rate. For unit economics reference, teams with similar workloads land between $70–$120 per 1M tokens depending on batching/quantization and embedding ratios.

Action: can you reply with the numbers above (1–3) and attach the usage export? I've attached a blank template for the usage CSV if you want to paste numbers.

Attachment: pilot-usage-report.csv (CSV)

Thanks — I'll loop in Neha for approvals once we have the numbers.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — quick answers below and attached is our usage export.

1) Current burn (last 7d): average 150,000 tokens/day (mostly chat). Last 48h spike to ~300k tokens/day during internal pressure test.
2) Expected next 14d: low 200k/day; expected 250k/day; high 350k/day during scheduled QA runs. That maps to ~3.5M tokens over 14 days at expected rate.
3) Budget/unit economics: we're targeting ~$90 / 1M tokens for inference (blended across chat + summarization). If we can get to ~$75–$85 / 1M via batching and a small quantized model we'd be very happy.
4) Procurement: we need a short credit approval for the pilot (no PO for this size), but if we move to committed reserved capacity we'll need a PO and SOW.

Request: can Redwood extend 1,000,000 tokens of free credit for two weeks so we can complete the QA runs and finalize production sizing? If you need, I can reduce the requested amount to 500k but the QA runs probably need ~1M.

Thanks — attaching export.

Attachment: pilot-usage-report.csv (CSV)

Jordan Ellis

Jordan — thanks for the fast reply and the CSV. I reviewed the numbers with Neha and Rishi.

Good news: we can approve a one-time credit of 1,000,000 free tokens for Acme Health to cover the next two weeks of QA/tests. Details and conditions below:
- Credit amount: 1,000,000 tokens free (applied to account ACME-2345)
- Validity window: 14 days from activation (we'll activate when you confirm the start date).
- Conversion: if consumption exceeds the credit, charges will be applied at your standard pilot rate unless you sign a short-term reservation.
- Finance: no PO required for this one-time credit; any recurring reservation will need a PO/SOW.

Unit economics note (for handoff to your team): given your expected mix, we estimate a blended $/1M tokens of ~$85 with standard batching and conservative quantization. If you can enable batching on the chat path we can likely get closer to $75 / 1M. We'll provide a short optimization checklist you can run before production.

Next steps / asks from you:
- Confirm desired start date to activate the credit (reply to this thread).
- If you hit >1M tokens during the window, let Neha and Rishi know ASAP so we can discuss a short-term reservation.
- I'll attach the credit approval stub once legal/finance signs off.

Attachment: credit-approval-20270912.pdf (PDF, stub)

I'll follow up with a short email to your procurement lead if/when you want to convert to a reservation. Thanks — excited to see the QA results.

Best,
